skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK Direct DMG to a single target with a 3-hit combo.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Increase own Hit and Specialized Hit by 50%. Negates target 30% [Evasion], [Specialized Evasion], [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Grants ownself 100% [Berserk]. Each strike can trigger 1 [Specialized Breakthrough]. Deals damage with 3 consecutive strikes to the entire row a fixed total of 3900% ATK of Direct Damage.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Specialized Hit 50% > 70%. Negates target [Evasion] 30% > 50%. Self [Berserk] 100% > 130%. Entire row total DMG 3900% > 5400%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Obtains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Reduce [Regroup] and [Revenge Revival] chances by 3. Negates enemies [Specialized DMG Reflect]. Grants [Immunity] to [Deterrence], [Stun], [Specialized Stun], to himself and ally in the same column.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Gains [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 60% > 70%. Reduce no. of resurrections by 3 > 5.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Gains [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 70% > 80%. Reduce no. of resurrections by 5 > 7.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Gains [Momentum Return] 2 times. Obtains 30% [Suppression DMG Reduction]. — [Momentum Return]: After all allies are defeated, return to battle with 110% (200%) Max HP. [Suppression DMG Reduction]: Reduce 30% DMG received, if ATK is higher than the Attacker, reduce by 150%.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Gain [Momentum Return] 2 > 3. Gain [Suppression DMG Reduction] 30% > 40%. Reduce DMG 30% > 40%. If ATK is higher, reduce by 150% > 170%.

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Mark a unit, unlocking a raid condition or bonus effect associated with the mark.
Revive effect: after all allies are down, the unit returns to battle with most of its maximum Health (110%–200%).
The defensive effect reduces damage taken (30–40%), increasing to a 150–170% reduction when the bearer's ST is higher than the attacker's.
A counter mark whose class number gradually increases the user's direct counter damage to marked enemies.
The stun control effect renders the target unable to act and reduces its overall damage immunity by 30%.
